title: The Design of Everyday Things
author: Don Norman
notes: A fundamental masterclass on affordances, signifiers, feedback, and conceptual models. Changed how I view everyday objects and software interfaces.

title: Refactoring UI
author: Adam Wathan & Steve Schoger
notes: Practical tactical tips on visual hierarchy, layout spacing, color selection, and designing from an developer's perspective.

title: Clean Code
author: Robert C. Martin
notes: Essential principles on readability, meaningful variable naming, function responsibility, and maintaining long-term code health.

title: INSPIRED: How to Create Tech Products Customers Love
author: Marty Cagan
notes: Explores how top product organizations discover and deliver technology products that solve real customer problems effectively.
